title: S06T02 - Migrate Codex and Claude integrations onto the manifest contract
description: Preserve current behavior while removing target-specific branching from project setup, skill installation, health checks, and environment manifests.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing Codex and Claude projects upgrade without path drift, duplicate skills, lost customizations, or changed no-leak boundaries.
Parity fixtures prove install, update, dry-run, uninstall, doctor, MCP, and skill execution for both targets.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
